title: Fix CPU telemetry basis
summary: Corrected hardware telemetry sampling so Windows CPU usage uses a reusable PDH Processor Information(_Total) % Processor Time sampler (true 0-100% utilization, aligned with psutil) instead of the turbo-scaled % Processor Utility counter that saturated the bar at 100%, while preserving the psutil fallback, and separated overall GPU utilization from NVENC encoder utilization in nvidia-smi rows.
reason: The Telemetry page showed CPU pegged at 100% when Windows Task Manager showed materially lower utilization, and GPU detail rows reused NVENC encoder utilization as overall GPU utilization.
behavior_before: CPU telemetry used psutil/Processor Time directly. NVIDIA telemetry queried only utilization.encoder and copied that value into both gpu_encoder_percent and gpu_percent.
behavior_after: On Windows, CPU telemetry uses a reusable PDH Processor Information(_Total) % Processor Time sampler (true 0-100% utilization, matches psutil and the classic CPU-usage number) with psutil as fallback and a defensive 0-100% clamp. The % Processor Utility basis was reverted because it is scaled by the turbo frequency ratio and saturated the 0-100% bar at 100% under load on turbo-capable CPUs even when actual utilization was far lower. NVIDIA telemetry queries utilization.gpu separately from utilization.encoder, preserving old six-column parser compatibility.
manual_validation: Live helper probe via apply_system_metrics_to_snapshot with create_cpu_sampler - WindowsProcessorUtilitySampler initialized and returned bounded CPU telemetry
refresh_summaries --paths telemetry files and MP-CHANGE-2026-0604-054.json - passed
rollback_plan: Revert the telemetry sampler changes in src/mediapipeline/core/telemetry/system_metrics.py and service.py plus the nvidia-smi parser/query changes in nvidia.py and gpu_usage.py, then rerun the focused telemetry unit and WebView smoke tests.
notes:
Fix CPU telemetry to sample the Windows % Processor Time counter (true 0-100% utilization) via the reusable PDH sampler, with psutil fallback and a defensive 0-100% clamp.
2026-06-04 in-day correction: the initial cut used % Processor Utility, which is turbo-scaled and pinned the bar at 100% on the 7800X3D while Task Manager showed materially lower utilization; reverted to % Processor Time (constant renamed WINDOWS_PROCESSOR_UTILITY_COUNTER -> WINDOWS_PROCESSOR_TIME_COUNTER, regression test added).
Also report nvidia-smi overall GPU utilization separately from NVENC encoder utilization.
Reduced TELEMETRY_INTERVAL_SECONDS 4.0 -> 2.0 in core/telemetry/service.py so the cached snapshot the WebView reads is at most ~2s old (CPU/GPU drops after a finished encode clear quickly instead of lingering on the prior sample); frontend 4s refreshAll cadence left unchanged.
Generated summaries for system_metrics.py, service.py, and test_telemetry_service.py should be refreshed (refresh_summaries).
